title: Loose Change agent: an open agentic website for private bank statements

parts.label: Start page
parts.text: Hi, I'm Khozhijon. This is Loose Change agent, an open agentic website. Your statement never leaves this tab, and the AI is the one you choose.

parts.label: Sample statement and alerts
parts.text: Drop in a bank statement and the page finds forgotten subscriptions, price rises, double charges and bank fees. Seven hundred ninety-one dollars a year in this sample, with plain rules and no AI.

parts.label: The assistant
parts.text: Now the assistant. It runs in my browser on my own Gemini key and reads the page through tools, so every number comes from a tool, not from the model. It can also file the merchants the rules do not know, and I can undo every choice.

parts.label: Another site calls it
parts.text: Here is the open agentic web part. Pocketbook is a different site with no statement tools. I ask it to review my statement privately. It asks Loose Change, and I must allow it. A window opens on Loose Change, I pick the file there, so it never passes through Pocketbook or its AI, and only a summary I have read goes back.

parts.label: Network file and source
parts.text: The network is a public Neuro SAN file, so any agent site can call it. It is open source. I led the project from idea to submission and directed an AI pair-programmer that helped write the code, which I reviewed and tested. Thanks for watching.
